picks.name: Byrne Chelsea Suede Boot, Brown Suede
picks.why: The brushed-brown Chelsea is the one boot the wardrobe is still missing, and this matte brown suede one is now £115, down from £280 and under the £130 target. Leather-lined with a Vibram sole, so it works for the office and the wet walk in. Wear it with the fawn chinos and a navy merino crew, or the 502s and a raglan sweat.

picks.name: Anglistic Sweater, Speckled Dark Scarab
picks.why: The office outfit still has no knit. This is a regular-fit lambswool raglan crew in a deep bottle green with a fine fleck, 30% off at £76.30, with only a small woven label at the hem. Wear it over a charcoal tee with the fawn chinos and brown Docs, or with the 502s at the weekend.

picks.name: AIRism Cotton Crew Neck T-Shirt, Olive
picks.why: Tees are still the biggest gap: five of the outfit formulas start with one. A plain regular-fit olive crew with no logo, smooth enough to sit cleanly under the raglan sweats and a knit. Wear it with the navy chinos and Sambas, or under the field jacket for photography walks.
